title: Same field. Different view.
status: SILENT CAMERA STUDY · ORIGINAL NORMALIZED GEOMETRY · NOT APPROVED

cues.heading: Two curves. One outline?
cues.caption: These two ideal dipole field lines occupy different depths.

cues.heading: Looking along y hides depth
cues.caption: Solid: φ = +60°. Dashed: φ = −60°. Their x,z projections overlap.

cues.heading: Turn only the camera
cues.caption: All 3D points stay fixed. The orthographic camera turns by 30°.

cues.heading: Now their projections separate
cues.caption: The dashed curve is edge-on. Neither the curves nor the field changed.

cues.heading: A view is not the field
cues.caption: Prediction: turn the camera back. Will the outlines overlap again?

axis_note:
h = x cos α + y sin α
z stays fixed
source_lines: Ideal +z dipole: r = sin²θ, fixed φ.
NASA CCMC: Properties of Magnetic Dipoles
